title: Your words, in every language.
subtitle: Create a project, import your Base Language strings, and make them feel at home.
name: Project name
languageHint: Use language tags such as en, fr, de, or ar. Separate target languages with commas.
emptyProjects: Your first localisation project starts here.
importHint: Flat or nested JSON with string values, up to 1 MB and 32 path segments. Reimporting keeps existing translations and entries.
emptyEntries: Import a Base Language JSON file to start translating.
review: Base text changed — review and save

errors.invalidRequest: Check the supplied fields and language tags.
errors.invalidResource: Use a non-empty JSON object with unique keys and string leaves (up to 5,000 entries, 32 path segments). Arrays and empty objects are unsupported.
errors.notFound: That project or translation key could not be found.
errors.placeholders: Keep the same brace placeholders as the Base Language text.
errors.incompleteExport: Translate every string and review changed Base Language text before exporting this language.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large. Choose a file no larger than 1 MB.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidLanguages: Choose distinct project languages, different from the Base Language (up to 100 total).
errors.pathConflict: An imported string conflicts with a retained object path. Keep the existing hierarchy and try again.
errors.invalidMappings: Confirm a unique language for every file (maximum 20 files).
errors.batchTooLarge: Select at most 20 files and 10 MB in total.
errors.baseFileRequired: Include and confirm a file for the chosen Base Language.
errors.stalePreview: The project changed. Reload the project and analyse again before applying or restoring.
errors.conflictPolicyRequired: Choose how to resolve translation conflicts.

batch.title: Import existing locale files
batch.hint: Select up to 20 JSON files (1 MB each, 10 MB total). Confirm each language. The Base Language defines the resource paths; unmatched target keys are skipped.

history.title: Project history and export
history.retention: The most recent 100 revisions are retained per project. Imports and restorations create checkpoints; individual translation saves do not.
history.warning: Restore revision {{id}}? This replaces the current languages, entries, translations and review states. Unsaved edits will be discarded. A checkpoint of the current state will be retained; audit history is preserved.
